plain_language_statement: The next clinically relevant test is a frozen external validation of the monitoring score on a correctly structured paired cohort.
The next progression test requires a microglia-compatible longitudinal package with repeated confirmed-disability data and provenance.
Seeded method simulations indicate that a very small monitoring-validation cohort may remain inconclusive unless the true effect is large and labels are clean.
The audited public-data search found no fresh ready-to-run primary monitoring-validation cohort; Gafson remains an access request and Karolinska requires response-label mapping.
MS involves immune-mediated injury in the central nervous system, including damage to myelin and nerve fibers.
Relapse activity and disability progression are related but not interchangeable outcomes.
A CD44/CXCR4-high MS microglial state was reproduced in bounded analyses, but one discovery partition was strongly brain-bank sensitive.
Brain-bank or acquisition-source imbalance can mimic a disease signal when source and diagnosis are entangled.
A coupled APC remodeling pattern recurs across the held data, linking HLA-II, IFN/APC, MIF/CD74-related state, IFN readout, and lysosomal processing.
Adding coupled-axis features or flexible multifeature models did not improve the locked monitoring score.
The project could not validate a broad patient-level immune-state simulator from the held data.
Joint inference recovered the already-known APC and immune-tone structures but no unexpected held-out-validated signal.
The rational discovery boundary is new data rather than more unconstrained mining of the same held corpus.
Project-grounded findings are rerunnable here; provisional findings have some internal support but still need decisive outside validation.
Outside-source knowledge is kept separate as context and never becomes project evidence merely by being cited.
Claude, Gemini, and RPT can suggest questions or confusion points, but their output is not evidence.
In the project's 20-item documented failure frame, context or axis dependence was enriched among cross-axis transfer failures; direction and modality patterns were suggestive rather than established.
Among the tested autoimmune comparators, ulcerative colitis had the strongest genome-wide genetic relationship with MS.
At ZMIZ1, the same expression-increasing direction was associated with higher MS risk but lower Crohn risk.
The chr1 KIF21B/GPR25 region appears biologically real, but causal-gene uncertainty and restoration or up-function direction make it therapeutically hard.
PTGER4 was closed as a simple shared MS-UC target because multiple signals and disease directions conflict.
GPR25 was demoted from an early favorite after denser immune-QTL and direction review.
The bounded APC/HLA-II early-treatment score is the project's one live research lead.
The locked score produced mixed results across therapies and cohorts.
Within its bounded 19-person evidence set, the simple locked score outperformed more flexible alternatives and survived several statistical stress tests.
The monitoring signal is not explained by the tested steroid-response or simple cell-composition signatures, but broader immune tone attenuates it.
A monitoring signal can report whether biology is changing after treatment without identifying what drug target should be changed.
The held corpus has no usable longitudinal molecular-to-confirmed-disability dataset for progression.
No V54 module became a portable progression-stage marker, and no candidate became a direction-resolved progression target.
Relapsing-to-progressive transition was not identifiable in the seven audited datasets.
The foamy OXPHOS and lysosomal morphology pattern was downgraded after global multiplicity and within-donor checks.
None of ten known packages qualifies for the complete P1 progression, P2 compartment, or P3 functional-direction role.
The exact CD44/CXCR4 microglia score is a future progression candidate by identity only; progression prediction is untested.
